'''2023 State Championships''' were the Players Committee's State and European National Championship events of 2023: one-day Open constructed tournaments run by local organizers with PC prize kits and Player of the Year points.<ref name="forum2023">Results posted in the "2023 States & Euro Nationals" forum and event threads on the Players Committee forum.</ref> Decklists were not required.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' various
* '''Results recorded here:''' 11 events, from the organizers' forum posts
